judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote a Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`), a single failing acceptance test in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`, and a brief edit to `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. It did not implement any validation logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or add `ajv` to `package.json`, meaning the added test fails immediately. Almost every acceptance criterion is missing, including the required test cases in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the new spec file `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, and the updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
